name: dogfood-webauthn-passkey-app
description: Dogfood app v1.21-2 — a WebAuthn + Passkey RP for Next.js 15 App Router that exercises credential creation + attestation + assertion + userVerification + residentKey. Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Chrome Virtual Authenticator + SimpleWebAuthn-shaped RP server) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/auth setupWebAuthnEnv) so behavioural fidelity feeds the release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/auth @kiwa-lab/core && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
